iterations_to_convergence.label: Convergence rate: iterations to convergence (initial search)

note: Path cost is the CRITIC ten-feature cost of each road when entered, for both algorithms. Convergence rate = N_conv, the iteration at which the initial search's best path cost had not improved for 20 consecutive iterations (Aadil et al., 2016); both algorithms stop on this rule, and a run that reaches the iteration limit first is recorded as not converged. Traffic is modeled, not measured. Lower is better for every measure.
